reason: After thorough review of Bristol-Myers Squibb's 10-K filing excerpt, no Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures were disclosed by the company. The filing contains extensive product revenue data, segment information, and forward-looking projections for individual products, but does not include any company-disclosed TAM estimates for therapeutic areas, disease segments, or product markets. The company reports revenues by product (Opdivo, Eliquis, Revlimid, etc.) and geography, but does not quantify the overall market opportunity or TAM for any segment.
